subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the grouped update of action code that receives repository credentials be approved as one unit after exact-head validation, or should the credential-bearing actions be separated for narrower review?
rationale: The patch does not change OpenClaw's secret wiring, but it replaces executable third-party code at several credential and publishing boundaries; repository intent is needed to accept the grouped trust update.

options.title: Approve the verified group
options.body: Keep the grouped PR and merge after upstream SHA provenance is confirmed and the rebased exact head has an acceptable required-check result.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate Codex, GitHub App token, and Docker publishing action updates from routine setup and scanning pins for narrower trust-boundary review.

recommendation.title: Approve the verified group
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped PR and merge after upstream SHA provenance is confirmed and the rebased exact head has an acceptable required-check result.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release-workflow history and direct awareness of this PR make this person the strongest available owner for the grouped security-boundary choice.
